_readme: Pinterest pin queue for KetoDial recipes. Account: Brew Brew (iambrew). To post: open pin_url in logged-in Chrome, then save to the pin's `board` field (default 'Keto Recipes' if absent) via the picker search box. Boards in use: Keto Recipes, Low Carb Desserts, Keto Snacks, Keto Dinner Ideas, Keto Breakfast Recipes, Keto Meal Prep. Post max 10/day to stay under Pinterest spam thresholds. Mark posted with date. MANDATORY (added 2026-07-11): every destination url= inside pin_url MUST carry ?utm_source=pinterest&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign={slug} — Pinterest's app strips referrers, so untagged clicks show up as 'direct' in GA4 and the channel can't be judged. New queue entries must follow the same pattern.
